$comment: Advisories deliberately excepted from security-scan.yml's blocking dependency-audit job (T20). E1 Part 10's container-scan failure conditions establish the precedent this follows: 'CVEs with no fix yet are logged/tracked... not blocking — a permanently-unfixable transitive dependency must not make the pipeline permanently red.' Every entry here must have a concrete, verifiable reason a fix can't currently be adopted — never a bare suppression. scripts/check-dependency-audit.mjs enforces that only these exact advisories are excepted; anything new still fails the job.

ignoredAdvisories.reason: Transitive dependency of @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node (via packages/observability). This codebase only ever registers the W3C tracecontext+baggage propagator (packages/observability/src/middleware.ts) — the vulnerable Jaeger header-decoding path is never invoked. A real fix requires an OpenTelemetry SDK 1.x -> 2.x major-version migration across every app/service, which drops this dependency entirely but is out of scope for a Dockerfile/CI task and risks regressing already-verified observability wiring (T11/T16).
ignoredAdvisories.discoveredIn: T17 (container image scan), confirmed via T20 (dependency audit)

ignoredAdvisories.reason: Next.js 16.2.12 pins sharp to exactly ^0.34.5 for its image-optimization pipeline; the fix (0.35.0) falls outside that range. Forcing an override to the patched version risks breaking Next's native libvips binary compatibility, untested. Tracked pending a future Next.js upgrade.
